result.summary: The page layout is largely consistent, but the featured 'Popular right now' card shows a stuck loading spinner overlaying an already-rendered image, and the favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in 'Popular right now' displays a circular loading spinner in the center even though the image behind it has fully rendered. The spinner appears stuck/orphaned and obscures the food photo.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator on the image's onload/onerror event and ensure the spinner state is cleared once the asset resolves.

issues.description: The favorite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button style (same background fill, icon color, and border) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The first card in 'Fastest near you' (Green Bowl Poké) has a very light, washed-out image background while the sibling cards use dark imagery, making the row look uneven; the white '15–25 min' badge also has weak contrast against that light background.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image overlay/gradient behind the badges so contrast and visual weight match across carousel items.
